senses.gloss:
Laba, ‘quail’ (Perdix chinensis) is one of the victims at the aśvamedha (‘horse sacrifice’) in the yajurveda.
Foot notes Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 5; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 24. Cf. nirukta, vii. 2, where Rv. x. 119 is called the Labasūkta; the Anukramaṇī (Index), too, gives Aindra laba as the author of that hymn. Cf. Bṛhaddevatā, viii. 40, with Macdonell's note. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 90.
